card.name: The digit 2 before 'nd' ordinals
card.fires_on: The digit 2 when it is the last digit of an ordinal like 2nd, 22nd or 72nd, so that 'nd' comes next. Seen in dose-reduction tables, infusion schedules, dates and titles.

modes.label: Dose-reduction ordinals
modes.description: The 2 in '2 nd' in dose-reduction or occurrence tables, often written with a space before 'nd'.
modes.example: Dose 1 st dose reduction <<2>> nd dose reduction 3

modes.label: Dates, titles, addresses
modes.description: The 2 ending a number like 22nd or 72nd, or a title like 2nd Earl.

card.writes: It promotes 'nd' and 'ND' endings and suppresses 'st' endings, so the ordinal suffix is completed as 'nd'.
card.plain: It spots a number 2 that is about to become 'second' (2nd) and makes the model write 'nd'.
